{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the number of unique patient_ids and sample_seq
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id count: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_ids: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id with sample_seq > 1
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check how many have sample_seq > 1
multi_sample_patients = duplicate_patients[duplicate_patients['sample_seq'] > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with sample_seq > 1: {len(multi_sample_patients)}")

# Check the distribution of sample_seq
print(f"Sample_seq distribution:\n{data['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check the severity distribution
print(f"Severity distribution:\n{data['severity'].value_counts().sort_index()}")"}
